jobs.title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. jobs.title: Creative Lead - EA Sports [Remote]
jobs.description:
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.



Creative Lead - EA SPORTS



Hybrid Work Model (Not Remote) 12-Month Contract



Whether you live for the biggest moments in sport, obsess over the stories behind the athletes, or believe great marketing can become part of culture itself, you're in the right place. The EA SPORTS team is looking for a creative leader to help shape the future of one of the most iconic brands in entertainment. We're looking for someone who is equally inspired by sport, culture, and bold creative thinking, someone who can build breakthrough campaigns that connect with millions of players around the world. This is a rare opportunity to work alongside world-class leagues, clubs, athletes, creators, and partners while helping define what the next era of EA SPORTS looks like.



You'll join a fast-moving, collaborative creative team where ideas are expected to travel from strategy to execution. The role requires someone who can think at a campaign level, inspire teams across disciplines, and maintain a high creative bar while navigating multiple workstreams simultaneously.



You will play an instrumental role in the following:

• Champion and evolve the EA SPORTS creative platform across campaigns and initiatives.

• Lead the development of integrated campaign concepts from insight through execution.

• Partner with design, strategy, production and brand teams to create culturally relevant work that moves audiences.

• Present creative work to senior leadership and articulate the thinking behind it.

• Guide creative development across internal teams and external agency partners.

• Help raise the overall creative standard across the EA SPORTS ecosystem.



This role will lead the creative development of marketing campaigns across the EA SPORTS portfolio: crafting concepts, defining creative direction, shaping storytelling, and ensuring every execution meets the highest creative standard. You'll partner closely with internal teams and external production partners to bring ambitious ideas to life from pitch through delivery.



EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• 7+ years of experience developing integrated creative campaigns for brands, entertainment or agencies

• Exceptional concepting, storytelling and writing skills

• A portfolio demonstrating breakthrough creative thinking across multiple channels

• Experience leading integrated campaigns from insight through production

• Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting work to senior stakeholders

• Proven ability to collaborate across strategy, design, production and marketing

• Deep appreciation for sports culture and the role creativity plays within it

• Knowledge of EA SPORTS franchises and gaming is a strong plus



Pay Transparency - North America



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).



PAY RANGES



* California (depending on location e.g. Los Angeles vs. San Francisco) *$127,700 - $190,600 USD



Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.



In the US, we offer a package of benefits including paid time off (3 weeks per year to start), 80 hours per year of sick time, 16 paid company holidays per year, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to temporary full-time employees scheduled to work full time.



About Electronic Arts



We're proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.



We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.



Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

We provide all of the marketing expertise-and none of the agency fluff. 




We are seeking a Creative Lead to lead and shape the next phase of creative at Right Side Up. This role goes beyond execution-it's about driving performance through creative, leading talent, and helping shape strategy across a diverse client portfolio (B2B, D2C, SMB, and beyond).




You will play a key role in connecting creative work to real business outcomes, using data, insights, and emerging tools to guide decisions and unlock growth for our clients.




This is a highly collaborative, client-facing role that blends creative direction, performance thinking, and team leadership.

 Lead the creative direction across multiple clients, ensuring work is both high-quality and grounded in strategy.

 Set a high bar for creative work while balancing brand storytelling with measurable results.
Performance-Driven Creative

Talent & Team Management



 Manage and mentor a distributed team of designers, copywriters, and freelancers.
 Assign the right talent to the right projects based on strengths and client needs.
 Provide clear feedback and direction to help the team grow and do their best work.
 Build a collaborative, accountable, and supportive team environment.
Client Leadership



 Build strong relationships with clients and act as a trusted creative partner.
 Present work clearly and confidently, guiding conversations and incorporating feedback.
 Help clients understand how creative ties to performance and business results.
 Support or lead new business efforts when needed.
Cross-Functional Collaboration



 Work closely with growth marketers, strategists, and account leads to align creative with broader goals.
 Help improve how we produce, test, and iterate on creative internally.
AI & Innovation



 Stay curious about new tools and technologies, including AI, and look for ways they can improve how we work.
 Explore opportunities to use these tools to increase speed, quality, and scale.




Who You Are



Experience



 5+ years in a creative agency or similar environment, with experience managing creative teams.
 Experience working on performance marketing campaigns such as paid social or lifecycle.
Strategic & Analytical



 Comfortable looking at performance data and using it to inform creative decisions.

 Strong background in concepting, campaign development, and visual storytelling.
 Proficient in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
Leadership & Communication



 Able to manage both clients and teams effectively.
 Clear, confident communicator with strong presentation skills.
Adaptability



 Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Willing to take on new challenges and help shape how the team works.
Curiosity for Innovation



 Interested in how new tools and technologies are changing creative work.
 Open to experimenting with new ways of working.




Why this role is different




This is not a traditional Art Director role.




In this role, you will be expected to think beyond execution, connect creative to performance, and play a meaningful role in shaping both the work and the team behind it.




If you're excited about the intersection of creativity and performance, and want to help build something impactful, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
HireLatam is a premier recruitment agency that places top Latin American talent in independent contractor roles in US companies. With a proven track record and a commitment to excellence, we're your trusted partner in the pursuit of career success. Our extensive network, personalized approach, and supportive guidance ensure that you're in the best hands to find your next independent contracting opportunity.


 



Job Title: Remote Short-Form Video Editor & Creative Lead (100% Work From Home) 



Location: Remote from Latin America


Position Type: Full-time


Salary: $2,500 – $3,500 USD monthly salary (Paid directly in USD)


Schedule: Dynamic schedule requiring availability between 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM US Eastern Time / EST, aiming to wrap by 6:00 PM EST daily.


 




Job Overview



 


Our Client is a premier digital marketing and media agency backing top content creators and podcasters globally. Generating over 5 billion views annually across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, they specialize in repurposing long-form podcasts and media into viral, short-form video assets. Obsessed with creator growth, audience engagement, and platform retention, they rely on highly skilled editorial and creative strategy leaders to oversee video production pipelines and maintain exceptional quality control across every client account.


 


The Role
 
Our Client is seeking a hands-on, analytical Lead Short-Form Video Editor & Creative Manager to own their video review, clip curation, and short-form content strategy end-to-end. Functioning as a high-level "player-coach," this practitioner will review all editor outputs, analyze social performance trends, curate top moments from podcasts, and direct video iterations before assets reach clients. Operating full-time during US Eastern hours with flexible availability across content flow peaks, this leader bridges the gap between raw video assets, editor execution, and client retention.

 


Key Responsibilities 


 

Creative Quality Control & Asset Sign-Off
 


Oversees and audits all short-form content prior to client delivery, enforcing strict standards across story structure, hook strength, visual pacing, platform optimization, audio quality, and spelling accuracy.




Serves as the ultimate quality gatekeeper, ensuring zero defective or off-brand assets reach client review platforms.




Deeply studies each creator’s unique brand identity, tone, and audience goals to ensure editing styles remain continuously aligned.




 
Content Curation, Sourcing & Strategy Optimization
 


Reviews raw long-form podcasts, YouTube videos, and live streams to identify, timestamp, and curate high-potential viral moments for the editing team.




Analyzes video engagement metrics across clients to spot performance patterns, test new hook structures, and refine short-form growth playbooks.




Experiments with fresh editing styles, graphic overlays, and platform-specific trends to keep content ahead of algorithm shifts.




 
Production Pipeline Management & Hands-On Editing Support
 


Directs the daily flow of content production, ensuring rapid review turnarounds, constructive feedback loops, and unblocked editor workflows.




Utilizes Adobe Premiere Pro to troubleshoot technical timeline issues, guide complex edits, or adjust cuts independently when necessary.




Coordinates cross-functional workflows using collaborative tooling (Discord, ClickUp, Google Drive, Slack) to guarantee on-time delivery schedules.




 
 



Qualifications, Skills, and Key Competencies
 
Required Qualifications

 














Short-Form Production Track Record: 2–3+ years of experience in video content production, with a heavy specialization in short-form video formats (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts).




Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro Mastery: High technical proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and short-form editing mechanics (pacing, hook engineering, dynamic captions, visual effects).




Editorial & Pattern Recognition Skills: Exceptional eye for viral storytelling and clip curation, capable of extracting top moments from long-form media.




Fluent English & High Detail Orientation: Advanced written and verbal English skills with an obsessive attention to detail to catch subtle spelling errors, audio glitches, and pacing flaws.




Schedule Alignment: Availability during core US Eastern hours (8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST availability window, targeting a 6:00 PM EST wrap time) to manage daily content flows.




Remote Workspace Setup: Dedicated quiet home office, high-performance computing hardware (capable of fluid Premiere Pro rendering), professional headset, and high-speed internet.















 

Preferred Qualifications
 















Previous experience managing or leading video editors and creative production workflows at a marketing agency or creator network.




Proficiency using modern project management and communication stack: Discord, ClickUp, Slack, and Google Workspace.

















 
Benefits
 





Competitive USD Compensation: $2,500 – $3,500 USD monthly salary paid directly in USD.




High-Visibility Creator Exposure: Direct hand in driving billions of views for world-class creators, podcasters, and media brands.




Strategic Career Growth: Strategic creative leadership role with direct influence over agency scaling and production frameworks.




100% Remote Infrastructure: Dedicated full-time engagement executed remotely from Latin America.

jobs.description:
Regional Creative Lead, NA, EMEA & LATAM


 


  Location: Remote in NA, EMEA, LATAM


 


  About the role


 Sky: Children of the Light is one of the most-played and most-loved games in the world, known for its art, music and emotional depth. This is a rare opportunity to shape Sky's creative presence across three regions: North America, EMEA and LATAM. Working hand in hand with our regional marketing leads, you'll shape how Sky shows up in our marketing across very different cultures, reaching millions of players.


 You'll be a creative director and a hands-on maker in equal measure. You'll lead creative concepts from insight through to execution, direct the work of our agency partners and internal teams, and produce work yourself across graphics, video and event assets. Above all, you'll make sure everything feels unmistakably like Sky while resonating locally in each region, holding one global brand together across three culturally distinct regions and their individual markets.


 


  What you'll do


 
  
   Partner closely with regional marketing leads across EMEA, LATAM and NA to ensure creative work supports each region’s strategy and delivers against its key moments.


  
   Lead integrated campaign concepts from insight through execution across all three regions.


  
   Own Sky's creative direction and quality bar in-region, guiding internal teams and external agency partners and building the standards they all work from.


  
   Translate Sky's brand positioning into a consistent creative identity that adapts to each region's culture, language and context, in partnership with global brand, global creative and regional marketing.


  
   Produce high-quality creative yourself across graphics, short-form video, social and event assets, often using in-game footage to create work that is beautiful, effective and efficient to produce.


  
   Shape creative concepts and briefs for creator agencies, ensuring creator work feels authentic to the talent while remaining unmistakably Sky.


  
   Present creative work to senior leadership and articulate the thinking behind it.


 
 


  What you'll bring


 
  
   10+ years in creative roles spanning design, video and social-first content, with a strong, versatile portfolio and the hands-on skills to take work from concept to finished asset yourself.


  
   Proven experience setting creative vision and raising the quality bar across internal teams and multiple agency partners, ensuring cohesive, on-brand execution.


  
   A strong cross-functional collaborator and communicator, able to build trusted relationships and present work to senior stakeholders across global brand, global creative, regional marketing and external partners, working across time zones. This is critical to the role.


  
   Experience creating culturally relevant work across multiple regions or markets, with a feel for what stays global and what must be local.


  
   Experience producing creative for live events and experiential activations.


  
   Exceptionally organized, able to manage multiple regions, partners and workstreams at once without dropping quality.


  
   A sharp eye for brand consistency, and a feel for what performs on social and with creators, not just what looks good in isolation.


 
 


  Nice to have


 
  
   Experience creating for games, entertainment, or culturally-driven consumer brands.


  
   Motion design, or in-game capture and editing skills.


  
   Experience producing creative for live events and experiential activations.


  
   Working knowledge of a second language relevant to our regions, such as French or Spanish.


 
 


  What success looks like in Year 1


 
  
   A clear, consistent creative identity applied across NA, EMEA and LATAM, adapted to each region.


  
   Agency partners and internal teams producing work to a high, on-brand standard under your direction.


  
   A strong body of creative work that supports major moments and always-on marketing across regions, delivered efficiently and consistently.

Associate Creative Director, Design (Remote)

The Associate Creative Director, Design will lead concept development, establish scalable design frameworks, mentor creative talent, and partner cross-functionally to ensure [REDACTED] delivers visually distinctive, culturally relevant, and high-performing creative work across every consumer touchpoint.


The impact you'll make:



Lead visual creative development across brand campaigns, social media, editorial content, lifecycle marketing, creator partnerships, and product storytelling initiatives.
Establish and evolve [REDACTED]' visual identity and design standards across channels and platforms.
Develop campaign concepts, visual systems, and creative frameworks that drive audience engagement and business impact.

Partner with Editorial, Social, Lifecycle, Growth, Product Marketing, and Studio teams to translate strategic objectives into compelling visual solutions.
Build scalable design systems and modular creative frameworks that support rapid iteration and cross-channel deployment.
Guide social-first creative optimized for Instagram, TikTok, short-form video, and emerging platforms.
Partner with Production teams to improve creative workflows and operational efficiency.
Explore and implement AI-assisted design workflows that improve speed, scalability, and creative effectiveness.
Maintain awareness of design trends, internet culture, platform behaviors, and emerging technologies.
Provide creative leadership and direction to designers, freelancers, contractors, and production partners.
Mentor and develop creative talent through coaching, feedback, and professional development.
Review and approve creative work to ensure alignment with brand standards and strategic objectives.

About VIVO
VIVO is a healthcare marketing agency specializing in consumer health, pharma, and medtech. We are a 100% remote agency with team members all around the US. Being 100% remote means we value constant collaboration, clear communication, personal accountability, and proactive problem solvers.
At VIVO, we believe health is more than a sector; it’s a life-changing mission. We are creators and strategists driven to make healthcare impactful and accessible, from first impressions to lifelong connections. We bring insight, curiosity, and compassion to every project, knowing our work helps patients, doctors, and everyone in between get the care they deserve—when and where it’s needed most. We’re here to challenge the norms and elevate health brands to inspire, engage, and transform lives.


About You
VIVO is a growing independent healthcare agency with ambitious plans for what comes next—and we believe exceptional creative will be central to getting us there.
We’re looking for a Creative Director — Art who can raise our creative bar, lead and grow our Art discipline, and help shape the future of Creative at VIVO.


This is a senior leadership role for someone who is as passionate about building as they are about making: building exceptional work, talented teams, strong creative partnerships, better ways of working, and an agency people notice.


You’ll bring deep roots in art and design, but your creative thinking should extend well beyond the visual. You understand how art, copy and strategy come together to create an idea, and you're comfortable helping lead multidisciplinary teams toward work that's strategically smart, beautifully executed and impossible to ignore.


What You Will Do
Set the Creative Bar.

Own and elevate the visual and creative standard across VIVO's client and agency work.
Lead the development of integrated ideas across digital, social, video, print, experiential and emerging channels.
Be hands-on when it matters—reviewing, challenging, refining and elevating work from concept through execution.
Push healthcare creative beyond the expected and help build a body of work that earns attention from clients, talent and our industry.

Lead Art. Influence Creative.

Lead, mentor and develop VIVO's Art and Design talent, creating clarity around expectations, feedback, growth and accountability.
Partner closely with our Creative Director, Copy to create a highly integrated creative organization where Art and Copy make one another better.
Think beyond your own discipline. Bring a strong point of view to concepts, storytelling, creative strategy and the overall quality of our work.
Evolve the structure, capabilities and future of VIVO's Creative department.

Build, Don't Just Maintain.

Identify the talent, capabilities, processes and tools we need for our next stage of growth.
Develop creative leaders—not just great campaigns.
Create an environment where talented people are challenged, supported and able to do the best work of their careers.
Partner Across the Agency.
Work closely with Strategy, Client Services, Project Management, Editorial and Agency Leadership to turn business problems into powerful, creative solutions.
Build trust across disciplines and eliminate the silos that get in the way of great work.
Be someone our teams want in the room for our most important opportunities and our toughest creative challenges.

Help Grow VIVO.

Play a meaningful role in new business, pitches and organic client growth.
Present ideas and creative vision confidently to senior clients.
Identify opportunities to make our existing client work stronger—and our relationships bigger.
Help build VIVO's external creative reputation through award-worthy work, thought leadership and visibility in the industry.

Embrace What's Next.

Bring curiosity—not fear—to emerging technology.
Help us integrate AI and new tools thoughtfully into concepting, design, content development and production while protecting originality, craft and quality.

A portfolio demonstrating exceptional conceptual thinking and visual craft
Strong network of talent and vendor relationships
Experience leading integrated work across art, copy and multiple channels
A track record of building and developing creative talent

But the most important thing is how you think. You're a builder. You care about developing people as much as developing ideas. You know the best creative departments aren't built around one person's ego—they're built around talented people who challenge one another and make the work better together. In addition to the salary range listed above, total compensation also includes generous equity, performance-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits.


	
	Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

	Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non-exempt employees

More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process.

This role is at-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

OverviewApplication

About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Creative Director, Copy to join our growing in-house creative team focused on OpenAI’s business audiences. In this role, you’ll help define how we communicate the value of OpenAI to organizations - from growing businesses and startups to global enterprises and developers building with our technology.

You’ll concept and write across integrated campaigns, product launches, customer stories, events, and other brand moments. You’ll translate complex products, technical capabilities, and business outcomes into clear, compelling ideas that resonate with decision-makers, builders, and teams adopting AI.

This is a deeply hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable developing a big campaign platform, shaping a messaging framework, writing a film script, or refining a headline. You’ll work closely with design, production, product marketing, and communications from the earliest stages of an idea through execution.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance creative ambition with clarity and decisiveness.

This role is based in New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

 

In this role you will


	
	Concept and write integrated brand campaigns for OpenAI’s business audiences
	
	
	Translate complex products, technical capabilities, and use cases into clear, human, and emotionally resonant stories
	
	
	Develop campaign platforms, messaging frameworks, headlines, scripts, manifestos, and narrative systems

jobs.title: Creative Director – Design, Enterprise Marketing (Remote)
jobs.description:
With a $90B market cap, we are a leader in the U.S. banking industry. Throughout seven unique affiliated bank brands who welcome customers at 400 local branches across the West, ZBC is committed to business and commercial banking because we believe that businesses are the cornerstone of thriving communities. Together with consumer banking, wealth services, and robust banking products and services, we are known for our exceptional service and deep local roots.


 


 

   Today, we are shaping the future of banking—leveraging innovation, strengthening local relationships, sharpening sector expertise, and delivering exceptional value across our family of great banks.


 


 

   Our newly founded enterprise Marketing team is a transformative organization that puts an in-house Creative Studio arm-in-arm with data, insights, strategy, tech, and governance teams to evolve and elevate how we tell our story and connect with customers. This is a collaborative hub for meaningful and holistic brand building, bold ideas, and breakthrough campaigns.


 


 

   We are adding a key role: A Creative Director for a new digital banking platform designed to move nimbly into the future and transcend our footprint while leveraging the ZBC foundation of strength and stability. The platform will require an equally dynamic creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design. This is your opportunity to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization and join us in setting a new standard for performance-driven design and marketing experiences.


 


 

   The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking.


 


 

   Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment.


 


 

    Primary Function


 
  Act as a leader in the creative visioning, stewardship, and hands-on design of the platform’s brand and its marketing approach.
  Deliver creative strategy and design of brand assets, guidelines, and marketing campaigns that will strengthen customer trust and drive measurable results across digital, print, physical, and in-person experiences.
  Collaborate with performance marketing teams and other organizations to optimize creative for ROI, conversion, and sustainment.
 
 


 

    Leadership and Team Development


 
  Work inside a multidisciplinary team and act as the key creative, guiding the work of a designer and writer (more may be added).
  Regularly connect with and seek direction from Creative Studio.
  Act as an evangelist for the platform’s brand and its application throughout the enterprise.
  Demonstrate expert level skills in design tools, methodologies, and production processes, and coach junior members toward the same, fostering a culture of excellence.
  Establish creative workflows that enhance efficiency and productivity.
  Maintain an extensive network of creative resources for freelance and recruiting.
 
 


 

    Brand Building and Stewardship


 
  Establish robust brand identity systems that work across many channels, ensuring quality and brand integrity across all touchpoints.
  Balance innovative approaches with regulatory requirements and financial industry standards.
  Apply cultural curiosity and cultivate knowledge of current trends in culture, advertising, and the financial sector.
 
 


 

    Data-Driven Innovation


 
  Use performance data and testing insights to refine creative strategies.
  Track and forecast marketing trends, technologies, and best practices.
 
 


 

    Vendor and Partner Collaboration


 
  Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and production vendors to ensure quality and cost efficiency.
  Maintain a knowledge of regulatory requirements and ensure application of best practices to avoid risk for the organization and ensure clarity for customers.
  Operate with organizational savvy in a collaborative, productive manner.
 
 


 

    QUALIFICATIONS


 
  Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in design and minimum 8 years of experience in graphic design, interactive, advertising, media, UX, and/or related fields.
  Strong visual, written, and oral presentation skills
  Bonus skills: experience with banking services, regulatory environments, transactional design, identity design and/or startups
  A combination of education and experience may meet job requirements
 
 


 

    BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION


 This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $115,000 - $175,000 annually depending on job-related factors such as level of experience and location.


 


 

    This opportunity can be located across the Zions Bancorporation Footprint or 100% remote within the United States.


 

 


 
  Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance start day one
  Life and Disability Insurance, Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance
  Health Savings (HSA), Flexible Spending (FSA), and dependent care accounts
  Paid Training, Paid Time Off (PTO) and 11 Paid Federal Holidays, and any applicable state holidays
  401(k) plan with company match, Profit Sharing, competitive compensation in line with work experience
  Mental health benefits including coaching and therapy sessions
  Tuition Reimbursement for qualifying employees enrolled in an accredited degree program related to the needs of the business, maximum of $5,250 per calendar year, employees are eligible for the program upon hire
  Employee Ambassador preferred banking products
